capabilities: Scroll text under a fixed cursor with hotkeys
Track plans, due reminders and publishing dates from a start page
Copy notes as Facebook posts preserving blank lines and stripping Markdown
Fetch and sort your own Threads post metrics in a dashboard
Capture ideas and browse inbox, library, topics, skills and files
extras: Warns that the Threads token is stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json and travels with vault sync or Git; AI titles and the Telegram inbox pull are off or desktop-only by default; each feature can be toggled off individually, requiring a plugin reload.
problem: Obsidian has no typewriter scrolling, no way to copy notes pasted into Facebook without losing blank lines, and no way to view Threads post metrics inside the vault.

relations.evidence: It calls Meta's official Threads API to read your own account's data.

summary: A personal toolkit with a start page for plans and idea capture, typewriter-style scrolling, Facebook post copying, and read-only Threads metrics.
